invariants.rationale: The result is constructed by HoodieListData.lazy(records), which should not return null.
The method operates on records; HoodieListData.lazy(records) expects records to be non-null.
The method always returns HoodieListData.lazy(records), which should be an instance of HoodieListData.
If result is a lazy wrapper over records, their counts should correspond (assuming records contains all elements to be wrapped).
Assuming HoodieListData.lazy(records) returns a lazy view/wrapper, converting back to list should yield the original records.
